name: domain.hermes_cron_scheduler
description: Hermes unattended natural language cron scheduler, incident classification, and blueprint catalog manager

entrypoints.name: schedule_natural_cron
entrypoints.description: Register a recurring unattended schedule using natural language or cron expression

parameters.name: schedule_expr
parameters.description: Cron expression or natural schedule (e.g. 'every morning at 9am', '0 9 * * *')

parameters.name: prompt_action
parameters.description: Instruction or prompt for unattended agent execution

entrypoints.name: list_cron_jobs
entrypoints.description: Query active, paused, or completed cron jobs

entrypoints.name: inspect_cron_incidents
entrypoints.description: Retrieve execution incident reports and error diagnostics for cron tasks

entrypoints.name: manage_blueprint_catalog
entrypoints.description: Query or instantiate curated unattended automation blueprints
